breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous constraint that end slopes are zero. It explicitly states 'The end slopes are free (not prescribed)' and proceeds to compute the slope at x = 0 using the standard simply supported beam formula, correctly acknowledging that the beam rotates at the supports under a UDL. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which omits the incorrect zero-slope boundary condition entirely.
